2608.23037.title: The Multilingual FrameNet Corpus
2608.23037.paper_summary: This paper introduces the Multilingual FrameNet Corpus (mFNC), a novel resource that extends the English Berkeley FrameNet corpus by collecting and harmonizing existing language-specific corpora across nine additional languages: Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Korean, Latvian and Swedish. By training models that rely on different architectures on the mFNC, we consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art Frame Semantic Parsers in both multilingual and cross-lingual settings, underscoring the importance of multilingual training data. The mFNC and our trained FSP models are openly available at https://github.com/beatrice-f/mFNC.
2608.23037.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹了多語言 FrameNet 語料庫 (mFNC)，這是一個新穎的資源，通過收集和統整九種額外語言的現有語言特定語料庫，擴展了英語的伯克利 FrameNet 語料庫：巴西葡萄牙語、中文、荷蘭語、法語、德語、意大利語、韓語、拉脫維亞語和瑞典語。通過在 mFNC 上訓練依賴不同架構的模型，我們在多語言和跨語言環境中始終超越現有的最先進 Frame 語義解析器，強調了多語言訓練數據的重要性。mFNC 及我們訓練的 FSP 模型可在 https://github.com/beatrice-f/mFNC 上公開獲取。
